about_the_game:
BONEMARROW is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility falls into disarray due to the meddling of a dark cult, you finally have your opportunity to escape. Defeat gauntlets of enemy mutants, find solutions to navigating treacherous paths. You may just make it out alive.

Melee focused combat

Push enemies into traps, parry their attacks, and defend yourself with a variety of melee weapons. Make sure to use them efficiently or they may break when you need them most.

Limited Inventory

You only have so many items you can carry with you. Make careful choices and bring the tools you use best to save yourself from failed escape.

Solve Environmental Puzzles

Figure out how to navigate the violent tunnels and overcome challenges that may need a more thoughtful approach than bashing enemies with a hammer.
